title: How to Donate
description: Supporting Hijaz Hospital Trust is simple, secure, and impactful. Choose the donation method that is most convenient for you.

hero.title: How to Donate
hero.excerpt: Your contribution helps us provide quality healthcare to deserving patients and strengthens our mission of serving humanity. Choose a secure donation method below to make an immediate impact.

receipts.heading: Donation Receipts
receipts.body: Official donation receipts are issued for all contributions. Please share your payment details with our Donations Office to receive your acknowledgement and receipt.

assistance.heading: Need Assistance
assistance.body: If you have any questions about making a donation, sponsoring a patient, or supporting a specific healthcare program, our Donations Office will be happy to assist you.

methods.title: Online Donation
methods.excerpt: Make an instant, secure contribution using your debit or credit card.

hero.title: Online Donation
hero.excerpt: A fast and secure way to support patient care from anywhere in the world.

body: Our digital payment platform ensures your transaction is completely protected. Once your contribution is processed, you will immediately receive an official receipt for your records.

methods.title: Mobile Wallet
methods.excerpt: Transfer funds instantly using JazzCash or other supported mobile payment apps.

hero.title: Mobile Wallet
hero.excerpt: Support our mission directly from your smartphone with just a few taps.

methods.intro: Using a mobile wallet is one of the fastest ways to ensure your Zakat and Sadaqah reach those in need. Simply use our designated Till ID or scan the QR code within your payment app.

wallet.qrNote: QR Code: add JazzCash QR in Admin

methods.title: Bank Transfer
methods.excerpt: Wire your contribution directly into our dedicated Zakat or General Donation accounts.

hero.title: Bank Transfer
hero.excerpt: Securely deposit your charitable giving directly into the hospital's official bank accounts.

methods.intro: We maintain separate accounts for Zakat, general charity, and specific infrastructure projects like the Medical Tower. This ensures every rupee is utilized strictly according to Shariah principles and your intended purpose.

methods.title: Meezan Mobile App
methods.excerpt: A Shariah-compliant digital channel exclusively for Meezan Bank customers.

hero.title: Meezan Mobile App
hero.excerpt: Hijaz Hospital is an officially listed biller on the Meezan Mobile App for seamless giving.

methods.intro: If you bank with Meezan, you can easily find us in the donations directory. This integrated option provides a seamless, Shariah-compliant way to contribute to our healthcare services without needing account numbers.

categories.title: Zakat Account
categories.body: Dedicated exclusively to receiving Zakat contributions, which are utilized according to Shariah principles for the treatment and support of eligible patients.

categories.title: General Donation Account
categories.body: For Sadaqah, general charity, and voluntary contributions supporting free medical treatment, surgeries, dialysis, medicines, diagnostic services, and other welfare initiatives.

qr.heading: QR Code Donation
qr.body: Scan the QR code using your banking or mobile wallet application to make a secure donation in just a few simple steps.
qr.placeholderNote: QR Code: add donation QR in Admin

methods.title: Cheque or Bank Draft
methods.excerpt: Mail or hand-deliver a physical cheque payable to Hijaz Social Welfare Society.

hero.title: Cheque or Bank Draft
hero.excerpt: Traditional offline giving through secure postal or courier delivery.

methods.intro: For those who prefer traditional banking methods, we gladly accept physical cheques and bank drafts. Please ensure your instrument is crossed and made out exactly as written below.
methods.footer: For assistance with your donation or to request a receipt, please contact our Donations Office.

methods.title: Pick-Up Donation Service
methods.excerpt: Schedule a convenient time for our representative to collect cash, cheques, or equipment from your location.

hero.title: Pick-Up Donation Service
hero.excerpt: Let us come to you. We offer a dedicated collection service for your home or office.

methods.intro: We understand that your time is valuable. Our authorized representatives are available to securely collect your charitable contributions, whether financial or physical medical supplies, directly from your doorstep.
items: Hospital beds, wheelchairs, stretchers, and patient care equipment
Other items supporting patient care and hospital services
methods.arrange: To arrange a donation collection, please contact our Donations Office or Hijaz Hospital Reception. Our authorized representative will coordinate a convenient collection time and issue an official donation receipt where applicable.
methods.closing: Every contribution, big or small, helps us continue providing hope, healing, and free healthcare to those who need it most.
